description: This file contains server-side logic for updating GSTIN (Goods and Services Tax Identification Number) associated with a party (Customer or Supplier) within an ERP system. It defines two primary functions: 'get_context' to prepare context data for the page, and 'update_gstin' to process form input and update address records accordingly.

methods.name: get_context(context)
methods.description: Prepares the context for rendering the page, setting GSTIN validation status and loading party details.

methods.name: update_gstin(context)
methods.description: Processes form data to update GSTIN information on address records, and commits changes if any updates are made.
